segments.text: HAVING declared the Doctrine concerning the Mediatour, which is the goſpell; it remaineth that we ſpeake of the meane, whereby wee are made partakers of the Mediatour, that is, of faith, without which alſo the preaching of the Goſpell profiteth and auaileth nothing.

The principal queſtions concerning Faith, are ſeuen.
1 What faith is in generall.
2 How many kindes of faith there are.
3 How thoſe kindes differ.
4 How faith and hope differ, and agree.
5 What are the cauſes of faith.
6 What the effects.
7 To whom it is giuen.
